bibl.title: "Tanto in vita quanto in morte avrebbe meritato miglior sorte": Evaristo Breccia su Medea Norsa.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, "Tanto in vita quanto in morte avrebbe meritato miglior sorte": Evaristo Breccia su Medea Norsa.
bibl.note: Medea Norsa, a woman of great humanity and culture, had Girolamo Vitelli as her teacher and had dedicated her entire life to the study of papyri to the point of being defined by Bruno Snell as the most learned of papyrologists. However, the news of her death went almost unnoticed and few people attended her funeral.
